rationale: Price is printing a new session high on the strongest 1-minute candle of the morning (27k shares versus 3-11k on the prior four candles), lifting it to 100% of the day's range while holding well above both VWAP (13.43) and the 9-EMA (13.58). Relative volume at 4.38x and a market backdrop of rising SPY with contracting VIXY supply additional tailwinds for continuation. The break above the 13.66 level that had capped the prior four candles supplies a clean mechanical trigger with invalidation just beneath that consolidation shelf.
